diagnostics.note: The baseline build succeeded and froze its binary, then host Python 3.9 lacked hashlib.file_digest. Metadata was recovered with repository Python from the saved artifact; baseline artifact metadata records the recovery.

diagnostics.name: macOS witness fixture
diagnostics.note: The original fixture tried to raise the hard descriptor limit and macOS rejected it. The fixture now preserves the inherited hard limit and requests soft 8192; targeted, full native CLI and aggregate suites passed.

diagnostics.name: portable introducer control-only root
diagnostics.note: An initial direct install exported the server consumer root, which contains no local implementation tests. Final portable installation includes the local source-owner partition and strict runtime filtering; the empty diagnostic run is excluded from performance evidence.
